## Problem

What's missing or awkward right now? Describe the gap this feature would
close, not the solution yet.

## Proposed Solution

What you'd like to see added or changed. Include endpoint shapes, entity
changes, or config additions if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't go with them.

## Additional Context

Related issues, ADRs, or external references that inform this request.
